Primarina serves as a good response to dragons, although it's slow. Kingambit is useful against ghosts, but I could consider Gholdengo as an alternative. I’ll order my picks as Rotom-Wash, Primarina, then Kingambit, focusing on exact species formatting. The deciding factor may depend on the opposing team's threats.
